lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Hello Wesner, it's Jean. Do you have a few minutes for our call?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Hi, sorry, I'm in the car but I can talk.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: How are you doing, really?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Tired, but okay.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Mm-hmm.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Did you hit your goal this week?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Only 1 days. Honestly I forgot about it after Tuesday.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Frozen vegetables count just as much as fresh, and they're cheaper.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I'll set an alarm on my phone.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You've picked your days.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Right.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Does your family eat salad?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Mm-hmm.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yeah, I think so. Between appointments and everything, there was no time.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What do you think the next step should be?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I'm going to do it Monday, Wednesday and Friday.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Do you think 5 days is realistic?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Uh, sometimes. Everybody gets home late, so dinner is late.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You have to make this a priority.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I don't know.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You're weighing it up, and that's fair.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I don't know.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Is your daughter able to help?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You're open to it. You just want it to fit your real life.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I don't know where the day goes.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: It's completely your call.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Where could the vegetables fit in your day?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I've tried this before and it never lasts.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Can I share an idea?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yes, please.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Beans count too, and they keep you full.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I bought spinach and actually used it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Part of you is already moving, and you want to keep that going.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: If I plan it the night before, I can do it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Whatever you pick is fine with me. It's your plan.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Is that something you can do?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Sometimes.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What feels doable for next week?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I'll try to add a vegetable to lunch and dinner on 4 days.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: On a scale of 0 to 10, how confident are you that you can do that?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Like a 5.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What might get in the way?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I'll do it right when I wake up, before anything else.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Let me make sure I got it. This week you did it 1 out of 3 days, the hard part was remembering, and next week you're going to add a vegetable to lunch and dinner on 4 days. Did I miss anything?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: That's it exactly.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Same time next Tuesday?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Perfect.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Okay Wesner, have a good rest of your day.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: God bless you.

flags.reason: Directive 'You have to make this a priority' after participant voiced doubt; pushes without permission and risks resistance.
Gave frozen vegetable tip right after the participant admitted forgetting, before exploring the barrier or asking permission.
Participant's doubt about 5 days and late dinners was followed by a directive rather than exploring the barrier.

score.summary: The coach moved the call toward a clear, specific plan with a confidence rating, a barrier check, and a summary, and used good reflections and autonomy statements. Early on, however, the coach gave unsolicited advice and a directive ('You have to make this a priority') that met the participant's doubt with pressure rather than exploration.
strengths: Line 21 and 25: complex reflections named ambivalence and openness well.
Line 27 and 38: strong autonomy emphasis ('It's completely your call', 'It's your plan').
Line 48: clear summary that checked for missed items and confirmed the plan with the participant.
coaching_tips: Line 19: replace 'You have to make this a priority' with a reflection or open question about what would make the vegetables a priority.
Line 8: ask permission before offering the frozen-vegetable tip, e.g., 'Would it help to hear some budget-friendly options?'
Line 17: after participant doubt at line 18, explore the barrier with an open question before testing the plan.
Line 12 and 23: use open questions (e.g., 'Who could help with dinner?') to draw out more participant ideas.
